'''Samuel Segun Okoya''' (born 20 October 1958, in [[Zaria]], [[Kaduna State]], Nigeria) is an [[Academic staff|academic]] in [[applied mathematics]] at [[Obafemi Awolowo University]]. He is the editor-in-chief of the ''Journal'' and ''Notices'' of the Nigerian Mathematical Society<ref>{{cite news |title=Nigerian Mathematical Society elects leaders |url=http://thenationonlineng.net/nigerian-mathematical-society-elects-leaders/ |location=Lagos, Nigeria|accessdate=18 February 2019 |date=8 July 2015|newspaper=[[The Nation (Nigeria)|The Nation]]}}</ref> and the First Occupier of Pastor E.A Adeboye Outstanding Professor of Mathematics (Endowed Professorial Chair) [[University of Lagos]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Don calls for intervention in teaching, learning of mathematics|url=https://guardian.ng/features/education/don-calls-for-intervention-in-teaching-learning-of-mathematics/ |location=Lagos, Nigeria|accessdate=18 February 2019 |author=Ujunwa Atueyi |date=25 February 2015|newspaper=[[The Guardian (Nigeria)|The Guardian]]}}</ref> He is the  [[alumnus]] to  attain the  position  of  [[professor]] and head of the [[Mathematics]] Department at [[Obafemi Awolowo University]].{{citation needed|date=May 2024}}

==Education==
Okoya had his entire tertiary education at Obafemi Awolowo University. He graduated with his bachelor's degree in 1983, earned his master's degree in 1986 and Ph.D. in 1989. His PhD dissertation, supervised by Reuben O. Ayeni, was titled "A Mathematical Model for Explosions with Chain Branching and Chain Breaking Kinetics".<ref>{{cite web |title=Samuel Segun Okoya|url=http://www.genealogy.ams.org/id.php?id=142922&fChrono=1 |website= Mathematics Genealogy Project |publisher= Department of Mathematics, North Dakota State University |accessdate=18 February 2019}}</ref> He is a Fellow of the Mathematical Association of Nigeria and Nigerian Mathematical Society. He regularly visits the [[Abdus Salam International Centre for Theoretical Physics]], [[The World Academy of Sciences]] and [[International Mathematical Union]].{{citation needed|date=May 2024}}
